statement_summary: Security lead, CPNI coordinator, certifying officer, and CALEA senior officer named in writing
Annual risk assessment with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; High risks never accepted
Sanctions including an express CPNI disciplinary process
No CPNI terms, no CPNI; third-party CPNI access register
Annual independent evaluation
Evidence file supporting the annual CPNI certification
Retention of CPNI, breach, intercept, and security records
Monthly advisory review; critical fixes within 14 days
Annual policy review; written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Named accounts everywhere; shared network login only as a dated exception
Least privilege; CDR and customer list export limited to 2 roles; scoped API keys
MFA for every administrator and remote login, including MSP and consultant
Termination checklist including shared secrets and hut access
Monthly account reconciliation and log review
Network administration only through the VPN with named MFA logins; no internet-facing management
Secrets in the password manager; defaults changed before service
Device lock; display-only account for the outage map screen
Phone release of call detail only with the PIN; otherwise mail or call back
Online access by password; reset by one-time code; assistant only after sign-in
Photo ID before in-store release of CPNI
Immediate change notices to the number or address of record
Sealed break-glass network credential
Look up only accounts you serve
No CPNI or network data in personal accounts or public AI tools
Lock screens; never share passwords or MFA codes
Security and CPNI training at hire and yearly; phishing simulations
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed policy acknowledgment
Intrusion runbook and outage checklist kept and printed
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour; outages at once
Incident register with the 64.2011(d) fields, kept 2 years
Reasonable determination of a CPNI breach recorded without waiting for forensics
Law enforcement notice within 7 business days; customer hold; state notices per matrix
CALEA compromise and unlawful surveillance reports
Outage thresholds, 911 contact notices, NORS, and DIRS
Insurer hotline first; MSP and consultant engaged under contract
Ransom only with approvals and an OFAC check
Vendor incident reports logged; Florida 10-day agent notice
Annual tabletop with the MSP and consultant
Lessons learned within 30 days, into training and certification evidence
Three levels; whole customer account record Restricted
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit; encrypted management protocols
CPNI used only as 64.2005 allows; no marketing use without adopting approval rules
Restricted data only in approved locations; exports deleted within 30 days
Inventory of systems and data locations
New vendors approved, under contract terms, and registered
Approved AI tools only
Stop collecting and purge driver license numbers
Off-site encrypted configuration backups; twice-yearly restore test
Factory reset of returned ONTs and parts; disposal log
Lawful-intercept information need-to-know and locked
Retention of account records and CDRs
